title: Format tooltip
description: A shared tooltip moves between formatting controls after one initial hover delay.
useCase: Teach a toolbar without making each neighboring control wait again.
interaction: Hover across the group, focus controls with Tab, or toggle formatting.
reducedMotion: Hints change position immediately; timing, dismissal and formatting remain usable.
limitations: One local four-button toolbar; this is not a portal-based positioning engine.
look: Light grey-green page with a white document card of dark serif text and a pale rounded toolbar of four serif formatting glyph buttons.
motion: First hover waits 400 ms before the tooltip fades in and rises 4 px; moving across the group while warm, it glides between buttons over 160 ms without re-waiting.
adapt: Delay logic lives in `show` and `hide`: a 400 ms cold delay, with `warmUntil` extended 800 ms on show and 650 ms on leave; `.tip` slides by `(tip ?? 0) * 48` px. Replace `names` and adjust the 48 px step.
